captions.linkedin:
Applying for a new or larger bank facility? Have the financial pack ready before the first meeting: banks underwrite on information they can test, and each bank sets its own list.

The CBUAE's Credit Risk Management Regulation requires banks' underwriting policies to cover due diligence and financial information from the borrower (Circular C 3/2024, Art. 5.2; rulebook.centralbank.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026).

What we'd have ready:
• The latest financial statements
• A 12-month cash forecast that includes the new facility
• Debtor and creditor ageing
• How the money will be used and repaid

Then the meeting is about your plan, not missing numbers.
